sql.h02.minimum: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM region WHERE r_name='EUROPE'), n AS (SELECT nation.* FROM nation JOIN r ON n_regionkey=r_regionkey), s AS (SELECT supplier.* FROM supplier JOIN n ON s_nationkey=n_nationkey), ps AS (SELECT partsupp.* FROM partsupp JOIN s ON ps_suppkey=s_suppkey) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r) region, (SELECT count(*) FROM n) nation, (SELECT count(*) FROM s) supplier, count(*) partsupp, count(DISTINCT ps_partkey) output_groups FROM ps
sql.h02.final: WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM part WHERE p_size=15 AND p_type LIKE '%BRASS'), ps AS (SELECT partsupp.* FROM partsupp JOIN p ON ps_partkey=p_partkey), e AS (SELECT ps.* FROM ps JOIN supplier ON ps_suppkey=s_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey=n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey=r_regionkey WHERE r_name='EUROPE') SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM p) part, (SELECT count(*) FROM ps) partsupp, count(*) europe FROM e
sql.h11.stock: WITH n AS (SELECT * FROM nation WHERE n_name='GERMANY'), s AS (SELECT supplier.* FROM supplier JOIN n ON s_nationkey=n_nationkey), ps AS (SELECT partsupp.* FROM partsupp JOIN s ON ps_suppkey=s_suppkey) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM n) nation, (SELECT count(*) FROM s) supplier, count(*) stock, count(DISTINCT ps_partkey) part_groups, 1 total_groups FROM ps
sql.h13: WITH q AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%'), f AS (SELECT o_custkey,count(*) n FROM q GROUP BY o_custkey) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM customer) customers, (SELECT count(*) FROM q) qualified_orders, count(*) output_groups, max(n) max_fanout, avg(n) matched_mean FROM f
sql.h15: WITH l AS (SELECT * FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate>=DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate<DATE '1996-04-01'), r AS (SELECT l_suppkey,sum(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) revenue FROM l GROUP BY l_suppkey) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM l) selected_lines,count(*) revenue_groups,1 max_groups,(SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE revenue=(SELECT max(revenue) FROM r)) winners FROM r
sql.h18: WITH q AS (SELECT l_orderkey,sum(l_quantity) quantity FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM lineitem) lines,count(*) quantity_groups,count(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity>300) selected_orders FROM q
sql.h20.shipped: WITH l AS (SELECT * FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate>=DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate<DATE '1995-01-01') SELECT count(*) selected_lines,count(DISTINCT (l_partkey,l_suppkey)) shipped_groups FROM l
sql.h20.final: WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM part WHERE p_name LIKE 'forest%'), ps AS (SELECT partsupp.* FROM partsupp JOIN p ON ps_partkey=p_partkey), s AS (SELECT supplier.* FROM supplier JOIN nation ON s_nationkey=n_nationkey WHERE n_name='CANADA'), sp AS (SELECT partsupp.* FROM partsupp JOIN s ON ps_suppkey=s_suppkey) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM p) parts,(SELECT count(*) FROM ps) part_partsupp,(SELECT count(*) FROM s) suppliers,(SELECT count(*) FROM sp) supplier_partsupp,(SELECT count(*) FROM ps JOIN s ON ps_suppkey=s_suppkey) selected_partsupp
sql.h20.prefixes: WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM part WHERE p_name LIKE 'forest%'), ps AS (SELECT partsupp.* FROM partsupp JOIN p ON ps_partkey=p_partkey), sh AS (SELECT l_partkey,l_suppkey,sum(l_quantity)*100 quantity FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate>=DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate<DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY l_partkey,l_suppkey), j AS (SELECT ps.* FROM ps JOIN sh ON ps_partkey=l_partkey AND ps_suppkey=l_suppkey), v AS (SELECT ps.* FROM ps JOIN sh ON ps_partkey=l_partkey AND ps_suppkey=l_suppkey WHERE ps_availqty*200>quantity) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM j) shipped_matches,(SELECT count(*) FROM v) threshold_matches,(SELECT count(*) FROM v JOIN supplier ON ps_suppkey=s_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey=n_nationkey WHERE n_name='CANADA') canada_matches
